Was Tim McIlrath, the bass guitarist of Arma Angelus, a Celtic punk rock musician

Tim McIlrath was the bass guitarist of Arma Angelus, not someone identified as Celtic punk. Spike Slawson is identified as a punk rock musician whose work has Celtic rock influences (through bands like Filthy Thieving Bastards), but he is not explicitly described as a "Celtic punk rock musician" in the provided passages.
